'''Dumbarton Football Club''' (nicknamed '''The Sons''') is a [[semi-professional]] [[Association football|football]] club in [[Dumbarton]], Scotland.<ref>{{cite web|title=About Us|url=http://www.dumbartonfootballclub.com/contact2/|access-date=6 June 2016|archive-date=1 October 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151001161306/http://www.dumbartonfootballclub.com/contact2/|url-status=dead}}</ref> Founded on 23 December 1872, they are one of the oldest football clubs in Scotland.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.dumbartonfootballclub.com/contact2/|title=Dumbarton Football Club -About Us|website=www.dumbartonfootballclub.com|access-date=19 January 2020}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.scotsman.com/sport/football/who-are-scotlands-oldest-professional-football-clubs-1478882 |title=Who are Scotland's oldest professional football clubs|website=The Scotsman |language=en|access-date=19 January 2020}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.west-dunbarton.gov.uk/leisure-parks-events/museums-and-galleries/collections/sport-and-leisure/football/football-dumbarton/|title=Football - Dumbarton|website=www.west-dunbarton.gov.uk|language=en|access-date=19 January 2020}}</ref> Since December 2000, the club has played home games at [[The Rock, Dumbarton|The Rock]] next to [[Dumbarton Castle]]. A member of the [[Scottish Professional Football League|SPFL]], they currently compete in {{Scottish football updater|Dumbarto}}, the [[Scottish League Two|fourth tier]] of Scottish football.<ref name="stadium">{{Cite web |title=Stadium officially renamed |url=https://dumbartonfootballclub.com/stadium-officially-renamed/ |date=26 April 2026 |last=Clarke |first=Fraser |publisher=Dumbarton Football Club |access-date=2026-04-28 |language=en-GB}}</ref>

[[Danny Lennon]] is the club's interim manager and has held the position since October 2026. <ref>{{cite web |url= https://dumbartonfootballclub.com/club-statement-frank-mckeown/ | title=Club Statement: Frank McKeown|first=Fraser |last=Clarke |work=Dumbarton F.C. |publisher=Dumbarton F.C. |date=14 October 2026 |access-date=14 October 2026}}</ref>"}}
